I'm off all day tomorrow, Sam took my shift. I'll grab Dad's trailer and we'll get everything out of Priya's garage before you have to leave. What time suits you?

Please don't move back to Rocky, not like this. You got hit by a hailstorm, that's not a sign to give up on everything. Your songs are the best thing about our band, so you can't quit on us. The notebooks might be pulp but the songs are still in your head, and we'll help you get them down again.

You drove out to Gatton at 2am when my car carked it after the Toowoomba gig and didn't even complain. Let us turn up for you for once.

And the landlord is a grub.

Call me whenever, even if it's 2am.
